summary: Frontend-only verification of hotel movement fix + interior wall visuals. Login admin@shooter.com/admin123 → Practice → Offline vs AI → Grand Hotel → START. After canvas click + ~6s countdown wait, held W (1.5s), A (1s), S (1s), D (1s). Confirmed movement WORKS: (a) SPAWN PROTECTED banner cleared, (b) HP dropped from 100 → 56 (took AI damage — impossible if frozen at spawn under protection), (c) camera perspective visibly shifted between screenshots. Wall visuals: cream wallpaper with vertical stripes + burgundy diamond damask motif, walnut wainscoting bottom, brass chair-rail line, brass cornice top — NO exterior window facades painted on hotel walls. Regression on DOWNTOWN: player can still move (HP 100 → 43 while walking, view changed) and buildings still show their exterior lit-window facades unchanged.

issues: Open sky is visible between the interior walls and the ceiling in some angles (see screenshots 04/06) — the 100x100 y_base=14 ceiling doesn't visually close off the perimeter, so you can see stars/moon/blue sky over the wallpaper. This reads a bit odd for an 'interior' space but is not the reported bug. Consider adding an interior ceiling plane / crown filler between wall tops and the ceiling to fully sell the indoor feel.

critical_code_review_comments: engine.js _collides fix (skip y_base>0) now mirrors localSim.collidesAABB and server-side behavior — good consistency. Recommend adding a small unit-like sanity check in future to prevent regressions on this important collision path.

Hotel ceiling at y_base=14 with 100x100 XZ footprint is fine for collision-skip logic but visually the ceiling is above the wall tops leaving a sky-gap; consider matching wall height to ceiling height or adding an inner ceiling plane.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Movement bug on hotel is FIXED (confirmed by HP loss + view delta after W/A/S/D). Interior wall texture (_makeHotelWallTexture) renders correctly with cream wallpaper, wainscoting, chair-rail, burgundy damask motif, brass cornice — no exterior window facades. Downtown regression clean. Only minor cosmetic follow-up: sky is visible above interior wall tops on hotel because the ceiling plane sits higher than wall tops; not a blocker.
rca of the issue: Previous bug: engine.js _collides iterated ALL obstacles, including the new 100x100 hotel ceiling at y_base=14, whose XZ AABB covers the entire arena. Any player XZ position therefore collided with it, freezing the player at spawn. Fix (verified): _collides now skips y_base>0 obstacles (floating/ceiling/mezzanine), matching localSim and server. Player can now move freely across the hotel map.
